review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, and a second production run (actor-spawn.json): cs_app::mission_start::recover_retail_aircraft_records re-read M01's aiv.zrd and the composed mission's MissionActorSpawnReport was recorded verbatim — 12 measured records, 9 spawned scripted aircraft, 3 zeppelin bindings, no refusals. Claim is implemented only. MEASURED: the record census, the enabled == 0 skip (0x474d10), the player record's engine-state path, the sleeper mark and the name-prefix vehicle dispatch are #1453's measurements; the records' stored poses are #436's and the zeppelin bindings ride #772's launched world-actor session. DESIGNED, the one value the task authorizes: the dispatch prefix is carried as the airframe/model label verbatim — which vehicle.zrd record each prefix binds is unmeasured — and every spawned actor registers a designed single-node damage graph whose integrity pool is Resolved::Unknown (no M01 damage table is measured, #668), so a routed hit blocks by name rather than draining an invented capacity. The scripted aircraft are kinematic bodies held at their spawn pose: AI flight is #1436's, not this task's. TEST-SELECTION NOTE: the prefix accept_m01_play_actors_ is unique to this task, so the 7 discovered assertions are exactly this task's tests. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
